authenticity_review: The image demonstrates high technical quality: excellent lighting with natural window light from the left, realistic depth of field blurring the background bookshelf appropriately, and convincing plastic material rendering with proper specular highlights. However, two artifacts prevent a perfect score: (1) The text 'ADVENTURES' on the rightmost background book is misspelled as 'AOVENTURES' - a classic AI text generation failure. (2) The green poodle figure shows slight structural fusion at the front legs where they meet the body, lacking clear joint separation compared to other figures. These are minor but definite flaws in an otherwise strong generation.
key_defects: Text artifact: Background book spine reads 'AOVENTURES' instead of 'ADVENTURES' (image_text_auditor extracted 'AOVENTURES' with 0.79 confidence)
Structural artifact: Green poodle figure has slightly fused front legs lacking clear joint separation (Router noted severity 1 structural collapse)
